'''2005 World Championship Day 2 Reid Smith LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2005-08-27).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35114 Thank Teh Meeker]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922140519/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35114 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Thank Teh Meeker'''
* '''Author:''' R. "Voice of Law" Smith
* '''Published:''' August 27, 2005
* '''Rating:''' 4.68
* '''Description:''' agents in teh court. pwnz u princesses

=== Strategy ===

this is teh deck i used to go undefeated at day 2 of worlds this year. all of team ohio also used the same deck, plus or minus a few cardz.

it does it all, and does it well:  battle, drain, retrieve.

teh space package is a giant c0ckslap and impossible 2 get rid of. especially teh b0rk3n tyderium with forfeit 8 musicians aboard that go to used with urchins! teh only thing that stops this deck in space is green cards.

on teh ground u have ur power 8 kitonaks and uh-oh musician beats.

then of course u have teh ridiculous adding two to drains EVERYWHERE. wow is that homo. and tawss khaa gives teh finger to any opponent's attempt to hinder your drains.

there are counter cards to this deck but A) nobody plays them and B) they dont do any fcukin good anyway

this is however a very advanced deck cuz there's about 500 bajillion things to remember and that's no exaggeration. so when you, random.swccg mof, copy this list and get smashed by your buddy's ralops deck, don't come cryin 2 me.

yes it can beat scum, i wouldnt have played this deck day 2 of worldz if i didnt think it could beat scum GAH

and it utterly destroyz everything else, especially that shtity bespin deck

one last note about why certain cards arent in there: it's cuz they arent as good as the cards that ARE in there, n00b.

pr0ps 2 nate "that other guy" meeker 4 teh original concept

rsmithw0rld domination 2oo5

a reidtech inc production
